svg.title: The staged plugin changes execution state
svg.desc: Repeat the staged plugin geometry and change the execution control under the new time card. A single state transition must carry the event rather than an explosion or newly invented mechanism. Pin the sealed to its execution confirmed state; the object silhouette persists while its status changes.
